definitions: To remove something from inside another thing or place.
To express strong feelings, especially anger, by treating someone badly or by being aggressive in another way.
To obtain an official document or service, such as a patent, insurance policy, or loan.
To clean a stain from something.
To destroy or disable something, especially an enemy target.
examples: Please take it out of the oven now.
Don't take it out on me, it's not my fault!
She decided to take it out on a new car loan.
Can you take it out of this shirt?
The fighter jets were sent to take it out.
